disambiguation: Despite the broad name, the plugin currently only offers goal tracking and a word counter.
extras: Most listed features (PDF/EPUB/MOBI export, habit tracker, device previewer, NaNoWriMo integration) are shown as unchecked and not yet implemented; the Usage section is empty.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for tracking writing goals or working toward a book-length manuscript.
summary: Book-writing toolkit that adds writing goal tracking and word counting, with export, habit tracking, and preview features planned.
